title: SkelPro template (format v2)
description: A SkelPro project template with declared variables, {{placeholders}} and optional files. See docs/templates.md.

$schema.description: Link to this schema, for editor autocomplete.

skelpro.description: Template format version. Templates without this key are read as v1 (a plain file tree, never rendered).

description.description: What the template creates, shown by `skelpro info`.

worktree.description: Always create the project as a Git worktree (same as `create --worktree`).

version.description: The template's own version, such as "1.2.0". Recorded in the generated .skelpro.json.

layout.description: What each folder is for. Written into AGENTS.md as the "Project layout" section, recorded in .skelpro.json, and used by `skelpro check`.

rules.description: Structure rules for `skelpro check`, recorded in .skelpro.json.

agents.description: Instructions for coding agents, written into the generated AGENTS.md.

instructions.description: Conventions for agents, such as how to run tests. May use {{placeholders}}.

pointerFiles.description: Files that just point to AGENTS.md, for tools that read their own file (for example CLAUDE.md).

variables.description: Values the template asks for. Use them as {{name}} in file contents and names. `projectName`, `year` and `date` are always available.

files.description: The file tree. Keys are file or folder names (may contain {{placeholders}} and / for nested paths). A string is a file's content; an object is a folder, or a conditional file if it has $content.

relativePath.description: A path inside the project. Absolute paths and .. segments are refused.

purpose.description: What the folder is for, in one line. May use {{placeholders}}.

naming.description: Naming convention for files in this folder.

id.description: Kebab-case rule name, shown in `skelpro check` output.

severity.description: Defaults to error for forbid rules and warn for match/expect rules.

match.description: Glob of files the rule applies to.

expect.description: Glob of the companion file each match should have.

forbid.description: Glob of files that must not exist.

description.description: Shown when prompting and by `skelpro info`.

default.description: Used when no value is given. Without a default the variable is required (except projectName, which defaults to the project name).

pattern.description: Regular expression a string value must match.

options.description: Allowed values for an enum variable.

condition.description: Include this only when the condition holds: `name`, `!name`, `name == 'value'` or `name != 'value'`. No other expressions are allowed.

conditionalFile.description: A file that is only created when $when holds.

$content.description: The file's content. Base64 data URIs (data:...;base64,...) are written as binary and never rendered.

propertyNames.description: File or folder name. Names starting with $ are reserved; .. segments and absolute paths are refused.

anyOf.description: File content; {{placeholders}} are rendered, \{{ is a literal {{.
